'''What Kind of Pokémon Are You?''' is the name of one song that was in [[Pikachu's Jukebox]] and the [[Pokémon 2.B.A. Master]] CD. A slightly different version also was in [[Pokémon Live!]] and the [[Pokémon Gotta Catch 'em Live!|Pokémon Live! CD]]. It [[Type chart#Generation I|lists]] the 15 [[type]]s that existed in [[Generation I]]. A non-lyrical version is featured in the game [[Pokémon Puzzle League]] as the theme song for [[Erika]]. ==Episodes== * ''[[EP058|Riddle Me This]]'' * ''[[EP064|It's Mr. Mime Time]]'' (Pokémon TV) * ''[[EP068|Make Room for Gloom]]'' * ''[[EP074|All Fired Up!]]'' * ''[[EP090|Stage Fight!]]'' * ''[[EP096|Meowth Rules]]'' * ''[[EP102|The Mystery Menace]]'' * ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]'' ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * {{an|Misty}} * {{an|Professor Oak}} (hand only) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Togepi}} ({{OP|Misty|Togepi}}) * {{p|Caterpie}} ({{OP|Ash|Butterfree}}) * {{p|Pidgeotto}} ({{OP|Ash|Pidgeotto}}) * {{p|Muk}} ({{OP|Ash|Muk}}, broadcast version) * {{p|Psyduck}} ({{OP|Misty|Psyduck}}) * {{p|Vulpix}} ({{OP|Brock|Vulpix}}) * {{p|Arbok}} ({{OP|Jessie|Arbok}}) * {{p|Lickitung}} ({{OP|Jessie|Lickitung}}) * {{p|Weezing}} ({{OP|James|Weezing}}) * {{p|Magmar}} ({{OP|Blaine|Magmar}}) * {{p|Golem}} ({{an|Giovanni}}'s) * {{p|Drowzee}} ([[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]]'s) * {{p|Raichu}} ({{OBP|Katrina|EP069}}'s) * {{p|Marowak}} ([[Otoshi]]'s) * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Otoshi]]'s) * {{p|Cloyster}} ([[Pete Pebbleman]]'s) * {{p|Bellsprout}} ([[Jeanette Fisher]]'s; broadcast version) * {{p|Magnemite}} ({{OBP|Ethan|EP101}}'s; DVD version) * {{p|Jigglypuff}} ({{an|Jigglypuff|anime}}) * {{p|Mewtwo}} ({{OBP|Mewtwo|M01|M01}}) * {{p|Wartortle}} * {{p|Diglett}} * {{p|Growlithe}} * {{p|Poliwag}} * {{p|Machoke}} * {{p|Gengar}} ({{pkmn2|giant}}) * {{p|Kingler}} * {{p|Voltorb}} * {{p|Hitmonchan}} * {{p|Jynx}} * {{p|Electabuzz}} * {{p|Lapras}} * {{p|Moltres}} * {{p|Dratini}} * {{p|Dragonair}} ==Lyrics== ===Original version=== ''What kind of Pokémon are you? What kind of Pokémon are you?'' ==Credits== * Lead vocals: Joshua Tyler * Rapper: [[Russell Velázquez]] * BG vocals: Russell Velázquez, Sharon Bryant, Kati Mac, [[John Loeffler]] * Guitar: Larry Saltzman * Co-produced and arranged by [[John Siegler]] ==Trivia== * The original airing of What Kind of Pokémon Are You? on [[Pikachu's Jukebox]] used the original first verse, but due to "grass" being mistaken for the word "ass", the DVD releases of Pikachu's Jukebox use the end of the third verse (with {{p|Dratini}}) instead. This results in both Dratini and the {{t|Dragon}} type being mentioned twice, but no mention of the {{t|Grass}} type. * {{p|Jynx}} can still be seen in its original, {{pkmn|controversies|controversial design}} in the music video. * Also in the music video, the footage of Dratini and {{p|Dragonair}} are from the [[Banned episodes|banned episode]] [[EP035]].
